sources: tools/JavaCreativeTabs.java run against the server jar after Bootstrap.bootStrap(): CreativeModeTabs.tryRebuildTabContents(FeatureFlags.DEFAULT_FLAGS, permissions, lookup) without and with operator permissions; data-driven registries listed in id order and tags in file order, as the client receives them
notes: Tabs are in registry order. `items` is a tab's contents when permissions change nothing; otherwise `player` and `operator` give them. `display` is what the tab shows; `search`, when present, is what it adds to the search tab instead (Java's TabVisibility).
Component patches are Java's DataComponentPatch JSON with the minecraft: namespace dropped.

player.display: union of the other tabs' search stacks

operator.display: union of the other tabs' search stacks
